panels.title: Pool Connections
panels.description: pgxpool connection state. total = acquired + idle. max is the configured ceiling. Steady-state idle ≈ total under low load; total approaching max under load is normal. acquired pegged at max means the pool is saturated — queries are queuing.

panels.title: Acquire Rate
panels.description: Successful pool.Acquire() calls per second. Tracks transaction throughput on the server.

panels.title: Acquire Wait Time Rate
panels.description: rate(db_pool_acquire_wait_seconds_total[1m]) — seconds-of-wait per second. Value 0 means acquires return immediately. Value 1 means callers are spending 100% of their time waiting on the pool (one full equivalent worker-second of wait per wall-second). Sustained nonzero values signal pool exhaustion; raise pool size or shorten transactions.

panels.title: Empty / Cancelled Acquires
panels.description: Acquires that had to wait for a new connection (empty pool) or were cancelled (caller context expired before acquire returned). Both are backpressure indicators; cancelled in particular means clients are giving up waiting.

panels.title: New Connections Rate
panels.description: rate(db_pool_new_conns_total[1m]) — connections constructed per second. After warmup this should be near 0; sustained nonzero means the pool is churning (connections dying or being recycled too quickly).
